## What's New in v1.5

### New Features
- Added free built-in connection keys, so users can connect instantly without needing to add their own server
- Added a professional-grade update to the Xray core engine for faster and more stable connections
- Added an in-app step-by-step Guide/Onboarding flow to help new users get started faster
- Added distinct brand icons for each connection engine (Xray, sing-box, Aether, WARP, Snowflake/Tor)
- Refreshed the app icon and adaptive launcher icon across all screen densities

### Improvements
- Improved DNS handling for the sing-box engine (local DNS + platform DNS resolver)
- Added LibXrayInvoke for more reliable communication with the Xray core
- Updated multiple screens: Settings, Stats, Subscription, Routing, Per-App Proxy, Server List, and Support
- General stability and performance improvements across the sing-box and Xray engines

### Notes
- This release supersedes all previous versions (older releases have been removed)
- If you experience connection issues after updating, try switching engines from Settings
